script.title: How Ambani’s Jio Hit a $137B Valuation #shorts

segments.text: Jio just became India’s second most valuable company.
Its valuation hit 137 billion dollars after a massive IPO surge.
How does a brand selling cheap mobile data get this big?
It is not just telecom, yaar. Jio built a complete digital ecosystem.
They turned over 450 million telecom users into buyers for streaming, apps, and shopping.
That massive customer moat drove a 27 percent surge on day one.

script.loop_line: And that subscriber juggernaut is why...
script.description: How did Reliance Jio reach a $137 billion valuation? We decode the ecosystem strategy behind India's second most valuable company. #Jio #PaisaDecoded #Business
